text:
elaine park: Quick plan for "Spark Session" launch tomorrow AM — need final hero image, 2x X hooks, LinkedIn longform, and routing for inbound demo requests. :sparkles:
ryan cho: i'll export hero (16:9) and two square thumbs. will add alt text and drop path.
sam irwin: i'll write X hooks (speed vs cost) + a 3-tweet microthread. mina can you take LinkedIn longform?
mina patel: yep. drafting LN narrative with customer anecdote. will keep CTA to register + checklist.
elaine park: UTM block: ```?utm_source=social&utm_medium={platform}&utm_campaign=spark_launch_q3&utm_content={variant}``` replace {variant} with x-speed / x-savings / ln-story.
social-scheduler: queued X 08:35 PST (hook A + hero + thumb1) and LinkedIn 09:05 PST (LN longform + thumb2).
jess-bot: preflight reminder set for 08:00 PST in this thread.
ryan cho: assets uploaded to /marketing/assets/spark_session/ (hero.mp4, thumb1.jpg, thumb2.jpg). alt text included.
sam irwin: microthread draft: Root: Shipping LLM features shouldn't mean slow responses or huge spend. Spark Session reduces latency and per-token cost. Demo + checklist: <link>?utm_content=x-speed
Reply 1: Quick dashboard peek — realtime token cost + per-route SLOs.
Reply 2: Autoscale case: kept latency steady during a 4x spike.
Reply 3: Register for a demo + 10-min setup guide.
mina patel: LN draft done — product story + customer quote. changing "link in bio" to "registration link" for compliance.
elaine park: routing: DMs -> sam, comment replies -> community queue. if sales-intent, tag @ryan cho and add Airtable row.
ryan cho: i'll wire the Airtable and notify SDRs on new demo signups.
mina patel: i'll post top-6 reply templates for pricing, private deploy, models supported by 08:25.
jess-bot: preflight ping posted at 08:00 PST. all set? :robot_face:
social-scheduler: preflight passed at 08:02 PST — assets & UTMs validated, posts confirmed.
elaine park: final ask: A/B test headline (speed vs savings) 50/50. sam, label variants x-speed-A / x-savings-B in scheduler. report engagement after 120 minutes.
sam irwin: will do. good luck team :thumbsup:
